name: Ever-Burning Wick
text: Your hero starts every Night with Ward.
flavor: Lit at the founding of Sconcewick, and never once gone out.

name: Brass Thimble
flavor: Grandmother's thimble. Surprisingly good armour, if you are small.

name: Lamplighter's Hook
text: +1 range on every card that counts from your hero.
flavor: Long enough to reach the highest sconce, and a little further.

name: Moth-Velvet Cloak
flavor: Woven from the shed wings of a thousand moths. It wants to fly.

name: Candlemaker's Mold
text: Your first Summon each seat turn costs 1 less Flame (minimum 0).
flavor: The old mould remembers every candle it ever made, and helps make more.

name: Bell of Saint Tallow
text: Once per Night, as a free action, Daze an enemy within 4 of your hero.
flavor: One ring of this small bell, and the Snuff stand stunned as statues.
